title: Schrödinger Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly write the time-dependent Schrödinger equation for a three-dimensional infinite potential well.

title: Wave Function
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct time-independent wave function for the lowest energy state.

title: Energy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the expression for the number of states N with energy less than E.

title: Separation of Variables
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate the correct application of the separation of variables method in deriving the wave function.

title: Energy Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly relate the quantum numbers to the energy expression.

title: Volume Interpretation
description: Optional Criteria: The student may explain the geometric interpretation of the number of states in terms of volume in a sphere.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the derivations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the Schrödinger equation or incorrect boundary conditions.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all necessary factors, such as the normalization constant, are included in the wave function.
